vb_textbox.text: Brown hat can be mostly bad! If pink is high, go for purple after and keep going until it drops. The scoring ranges from 0 to 9 mushrooms, so if you're regularly getting 6+ then you're doing it right, don't question your own instincts! If you start getting below 5, try switching it up. It seems to be chance based and/or seems to vary at the game goes on. If you do pick brown and it is high scoring, go for green flat cap. Brown/green and purple/pink seem to be paired together. Good luck :) Also, I am a human. I promise.
